post.description: Search the CMS NPPES NPI Registry for healthcare providers (individuals or organizations) by name, organization, taxonomy/specialty, city, state, postal code or country. Returns one page (limit 1–200, skip up to 1200) of full provider records: NPI, taxonomies with licenses, mailing and practice addresses, other names, payer identifiers and endpoints. Requires at least one of first_name, last_name, organization_name, taxonomy_description or postal_code.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

address_purpose.description:
Which address the city/state/postal_code filters apply to. Default: any.

Provider reference: allowed values ["location", "mailing", "primary", "secondary"].

city.description: City of the mailing or practice address. Up to 100 ASCII characters (NPPES rejects accented letters; O'Brien, Smith-Jones and St. John are fine); one trailing `*` wildcard is allowed after at least two characters.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code; US is the default in NPPES. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

enumeration_type.description:
individual (NPI-1) or organization (NPI-2). Omit for both.

Provider reference: allowed values ["individual", "organization"].

first_name.description: Individual provider first name (NPI-1 only). Up to 100 ASCII characters (NPPES rejects accented letters; O'Brien, Smith-Jones and St. John are fine); one trailing `*` wildcard is allowed after at least two characters.

last_name.description: Individual provider last name (NPI-1 only). Up to 100 ASCII characters (NPPES rejects accented letters; O'Brien, Smith-Jones and St. John are fine); one trailing `*` wildcard is allowed after at least two characters.

limit.description:
Records per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 10.

organization_name.description: Organization legal name or other name (NPI-2 only); also matches Doing Business As names. Up to 100 ASCII characters (NPPES rejects accented letters; O'Brien, Smith-Jones and St. John are fine); one trailing `*` wildcard is allowed after at least two characters.

postal_code.description: 5- or 9-digit ZIP, or a prefix followed by `*` (e.g. 941*).

skip.description:
Records to skip; pass next_skip from the previous page. NPPES allows at most 1200.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 1200; default 0.

state.description: Two-letter US state/territory code. Needs another criterion. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

taxonomy_description.description: Specialty / taxonomy description such as Cardiology, Dermatology, Family Medicine, Hospice Care, Community Based, or a taxonomy code like 208800000X. Up to 100 ASCII characters (NPPES rejects accented letters; O'Brien, Smith-Jones and St. John are fine); one trailing `*` wildcard is allowed after at least two characters.

use_first_name_alias.description: Also match common first-name aliases (Bob for Robert). Requires first_name. NPPES default is true.
